items.headline: Jacob Bridgeman Enters Top 10
items.text: Jacob Bridgeman jumped into the top 10 on the 2026 PGA Tour money list as Scottie Scheffler leads with over $30 million earned this season.

items.headline: Henley Unfazed by Scheffler Partnership
items.text: Russell Henley said his long friendship with Scottie Scheffler means he does not feel extra pressure to perform for him in team golf events.
